description: Source code implementing a matrix class with various linear algebra operations, including inversion, eigenvalue computation, Cholesky decomposition, and covariance calculation.

classes.name: matrix_t
classes.description: A class representing a matrix with complex number entries, supporting various linear algebra operations.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the matrix elements.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates and returns the inverse of the matrix.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Solves the linear system for the given right-hand side vector.

methods.name: conjugate
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of the matrix.

methods.name: hermitian
methods.description: Returns the Hermitian (conjugate transpose) of the matrix.

methods.name: row_reduced_echelon_form
methods.description: Computes the row-reduced echelon form of the matrix.

methods.name: row_reduced_echelon_form (no args)
methods.description: Returns the row-reduced echelon form of the matrix.

methods.name: null_space
methods.description: Calculates the null space of the matrix.

methods.name: eigen_vector
methods.description: Computes an eigenvector corresponding to a given eigenvalue.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Calculates the trace of the matrix.

methods.name: faddeev_leverrier
methods.description: Computes the characteristic polynomial coefficients using Faddeev-Leverrier algorithm.

methods.name: cholesky
methods.description: Performs Cholesky decomposition.

methods.name: eigen
methods.description: Calculates eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

methods.name: adjoint
methods.description: Calculates the adjoint (classical adjugate) of the matrix.

methods.name: minor
methods.description: Calculates the minor matrix for a given row and column.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of the matrix.

methods.name: covariance
methods.description: Calculates the covariance matrix.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the matrix data by subtracting the mean.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of the matrix.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Matrix multiplication.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Matrix addition.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Matrix subtraction.

methods.name: set_row
methods.description: Sets a specific row with a vector.

methods.name: set_col
methods.description: Sets a specific column with a vector.

methods.name: get_row
methods.description: Retrieves a specific row as a vector.

methods.name: get_col
methods.description: Retrieves a specific column as a vector.
